question: What order do DOM keydown/paste, Godot ui_paste handling, synchronous clipboard_get(), and later clipboard cache updates occur on Web?

sources.title: Godot Web input and paste bridge
sources.claim: keydown enters Godot synchronously then is prevented; paste event separately exposes event.clipboardData

commands: Export the same project to Web, open browser devtools, copy A externally and paste, then copy B externally and paste again
distinguishing_outcomes: Godot ui_paste/clipboard_get precedes DOM paste carrying fresh text: retain ordering bug hypothesis.
DOM paste carrying fresh text precedes Godot ui_paste: stale value must come from a different cache/update path.
DOM paste never fires after Godot prevents keydown: async clipboard_get permission/timing is the only refresh path for shortcut paste.
Text control receives fresh B despite clipboard_get logging A: inspect a separate browser-native insertion path before any patch.
stop_condition: Capture two external copy/paste cycles with DOM, Godot input, clipboard values, and resulting control text in Chromium and one second browser if available.
